headline: This law names a memorial at March Field Air Museum in Riverside, California, as the Distinguished Flying Cross National Memorial.
what_it_does: The law designates a memorial at the March Field Air Museum in Riverside, California, as the Distinguished Flying Cross National Memorial. The memorial honors current and former members of the Armed Forces who have received the Distinguished Flying Cross. The law also states that this designation does not require or allow the use of federal funds for any related purpose.
when_it_takes_effect: Took effect when signed into law on July 25, 2014.
